# Test fixtures

Files for the attachment up- and download tests, see `fixtureFiles` in `tests/helpers/fixtures.ts`.

- `redmine-logo.*`: the [Redmine logo](https://www.redmine.org/projects/redmine/wiki/Logo), shrunk to 300x100 pixels.
  Redmine Logo is Copyright (C) 2009 Martin Herr and is licensed under the
  [Creative Commons Attribution-Share Alike 2.5 Generic](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.5/) license.
- `bytes.bin`: every byte value (0-255) once, so any text decoding of the content shows up.
